cards.text:
Task 3. You are going to give a talk about household chores. You will have to start in 1.5 minutes and speak for not more than 2 minutes (10–12 sentences).

Remember to say:

· why it is important to share the household chores in a family;

· how household chores are divided in your family;

· what household chores you like and dislike doing and why;

· what your attitude to ignoring household chores is.

You have to talk continuously.

answer.value: План: вступление (1 фраза) → по 2–3 фразы на каждый из четырёх пунктов задания → заключение (1 фраза); всего 10–12 фраз, связки first of all, besides, as for, that is why, to sum up. Говорите две минуты без остановки, запишите себя и сверьте с критериями.
